hero.h1: New Construction Homes in Southwest Las Vegas
hero.sub: Forty two neighborhoods are selling new homes in the southwest valley right now, from three-story townhome-style homes in the $320,000s to single-story ranch homes near $1.5 million. Here is every one we verified, and what to check before you visit a model.

image.alt: New homes on a southwest Las Vegas street with desert mountains in the background

answer: Southwest Las Vegas covers Enterprise and western Spring Valley, including Mountain's Edge, Rhodes Ranch, and Southern Highlands. Most of it is unincorporated Clark County, not the City of Las Vegas, even with a Las Vegas address. As of September 16, 2026, we verified 42 neighborhoods selling new homes here from 12 builders, led by Lennar, Pulte, KB Home, and Richmond American. The busiest pocket is ZIPs 89139 and 89141, near Cactus Avenue and Rainbow Boulevard. Published starting prices run from $324,990 at KB Home's Chelsea Commons to $1,499,950 at Richmond American's Galway Grove. One tip: SID payments depend on the parcel, so check the exact lot before you sign.
takeaways: Enterprise south, mostly ZIPs 89139 and 89141, is where most of the building is. Twenty two of the 42 neighborhoods in our table are there.
A Las Vegas mailing address does not mean the City of Las Vegas. Enterprise and Spring Valley are unincorporated towns in Clark County, so the county handles services.
Richmond American says "No SID fee" for most of its southwest neighborhoods. We found no SID statement for the rest, so check the exact parcel before you sign.
Seven neighborhoods here from Pulte, AmericanWest Homes, and KB Home have three-story plans. If stairs are a problem, ask for the single-story plans first.
Seven more neighborhoods are coming soon, including Lennar in Southern Highlands and a gated Lennar neighborhood called Aurora Estates.
Register your own agent on your first visit to any model. The sales team works for the builder.

part1_sections.h2: Which builders are building in southwest Las Vegas?

blocks.lede: Twelve builders have neighborhoods selling in the southwest. Lennar, Pulte, KB Home, and Richmond American have the most, and between them they cover everything from townhome-style homes to half-acre homesites.

Seven Pulte neighborhoods. Tenaya Springs from $499,990, Paldona, Cordora, and Rainbow Crossing Luxury in the Rainbow Crossing area, Delamar, gated Hayford Collection from $795,990, and Daylight from $965,990. No Del Webb neighborhood is selling in the southwest.

Six neighborhoods and the lowest start. Chelsea Commons in Spring Valley from $324,990, Novi, Landings and Reserves at Aven, Tobiano, and move-in ready homes at Lynora. KB says a homesite premium may apply.

Six neighborhoods and three coming soon. Addison Place from $503,950, Lexington Chase, Archer Park at Mountain's Edge, and ranch homes at Eldorado Valley, Camden, and Galway Grove from $1,099,950. Its pages for Addison Place, Lexington Chase, Eldorado Valley, Camden, and Galway Grove say "No SID fee."
Aster Point and Granite Point townhomes from $395,990, Wisteria single-story homes from $599,990, and Marigold coming fall 2026. Beazer includes solar in all its homes.

part2_sections.h2: Where in southwest Las Vegas are new homes going up?

blocks.lede: Most new building is in Enterprise south, in ZIPs 89139 and 89141. Smaller pockets sit along Durango and Warm Springs, in western Spring Valley, around Mountain's Edge, and on the west side of Southern Highlands.

blocks.p: New homes here often have a Las Vegas mailing address, but that does not mean they are in the City of Las Vegas. Enterprise, which includes Mountain's Edge and Southern Highlands, and Spring Valley, which includes Rhodes Ranch, are unincorporated towns in Clark County. That means Clark County, not the city, provides local services. We found no City of Las Vegas area in these new home pockets, but you can confirm any parcel on the Clark County Assessor site.

blocks.p: The SID is the one people miss. Clark County Public Works lists its active special improvement districts, and we did not match any of them to these new neighborhoods. That does not rule one out on your lot. Richmond American states "No SID fee" for Addison Place, Eldorado Valley, Camden, Galway Grove, Lexington Chase, and its coming soon neighborhoods. For every other neighborhood, ask the builder in writing, and look up the parcel through the Clark County Treasurer, which points to Assessment Management Group. I explain how these work in SID, LID, and taxes explained.

part2_sections.h2: Where is southwest Las Vegas, and what is close by?

blocks.lede: The southwest runs from Spring Valley south through Enterprise toward Sloan, west of I-15. Most pockets reach the south end of the Strip by way of the 215 Beltway and I-15.

ul: Getting around: I-15, the 215 Beltway, Blue Diamond Road (SR 160), and St. Rose Parkway (SR 146). Main streets include Durango, Rainbow, Buffalo, Fort Apache, Cactus, Warm Springs, and Blue Diamond.
Mountain's Edge trails: Richmond American's Archer Park page points to trails nearby.
Southern Highlands: 24/7 roving patrol by Securitas, and private gated enclaves by Blue Heron.
Hospital: St. Rose Dominican San Martín Campus, 147 beds, at 8280 W Warm Springs Road in 89113.
Builder extras: Beazer includes solar in all its homes, Signature's Royal Ridge Estates has solar, and Archer Park offers Richmond American's UltraGarage.

blocks.p: Drive times change a lot by time of day. If a commute matters, test it at rush hour before you pick a lot.

part2_sections.h2: What should you know before buying new in southwest Las Vegas?

blocks.lede: The southwest has a lot of choices at many price points, but a few things catch new buyers off guard.

ul: Check who governs the address. A Las Vegas address here is almost always unincorporated Clark County. Confirm the parcel on the Clark County Assessor site.
Check the SID on the exact lot. It depends on the parcel. Richmond American says "No SID fee" for most of its neighborhoods here, but we found no SID statement from the other builders.
Get every HOA number. Southern Highlands has a master HOA plus a sub-association, and official dollar amounts are not published.
Budget for the lot. KB Home says a homesite premium may apply.
Ask about stairs. Paldona, Cordora, Delamar, Hayford Collection, Rainbow Crossing Luxury, Quinn Canyon, and Chelsea Commons all have three-story plans.
Know what "home" means. Caliterra sells Duo (paired) homes, and Beazer's Aster Point and Granite Point are townhomes.
Do not assume a gate. Hayford Collection, The Bluffs at Southern Highlands, and Aurora Estates (coming soon) are gated. Most other neighborhoods here are not.
Watch the brand name. Pulte now sells Quinn Canyon and Wesley Park under its AmericanWest Homes brand.
Coming soon means no real price yet. Montclair, Aurora Estates, and Lennar's Southern Highlands show rounded "From" prices only.
Look past the MLS. Some new homes are sold directly by the builder and may not show up on listing sites.

part2_sections.h2: Why bring your own agent to a southwest Las Vegas model home?

blocks.lede: The friendly person at the sales desk works for the builder. Their job is to sell that builder's homes at that builder's price.

blocks.p: In the southwest you might be comparing a Lennar home in 89139, a Pulte three-story near Rainbow Crossing, and a Richmond American ranch in Mountain's Edge, each with different lot premiums, HOAs, and SID answers. Having someone on your side who lines those up costs you nothing, because the builder pays the buyer agent commission either way. The one rule: most builders require your agent to be registered on your very first visit. Here is what having your own agent actually changes.

faq: Is southwest Las Vegas in the City of Las Vegas?

Mostly no. Enterprise and Spring Valley are unincorporated towns in Clark County, even with a Las Vegas mailing address. Mountain's Edge and Southern Highlands are in Enterprise, and Rhodes Ranch is in Spring Valley.
What is the cheapest new construction in southwest Las Vegas right now?

Chelsea Commons by KB Home in 89148, with three-story townhome-style homes from $324,990 as of September 16, 2026. The lowest detached home we found is The Richardson by Lennar in 89139, from $419,990.
Which builders are building in Mountain's Edge?

Richmond American sells Archer Park at Mountain's Edge, ranch plans from 2,390 to 2,830 square feet from $732,950. Lennar's Triad Springs, Century's Southwind, and Storybook's Ivyleaf Square are also in ZIP 89178, but we could not confirm they are inside the Mountain's Edge master plan.
Do new homes in southwest Las Vegas have SID fees?

It depends on the parcel. Richmond American states "No SID fee" for most of its southwest neighborhoods, but we found no SID statement from other builders. Check the exact parcel with the Clark County Treasurer before you sign.
What do new homes cost in 89141 and 89139?

Redfin showed 46 new homes for sale in 89141 at a $579K median listing price, and 36 in 89139 at a $531K median, on September 16, 2026. Builder starting prices in those ZIPs run from $410,990 to $1,144,950.
Are there single-story new homes in southwest Las Vegas?
Yes. Beazer's Wisteria starts at $599,990, Pulte's Daylight at $965,990, and Richmond American sells ranch plans at Archer Park, Eldorado Valley, Camden, and Galway Grove.
What schools serve new homes near Cactus and Rainbow?
Pulte lists Fine Elementary, Canarelli Middle, and Desert Oasis High for Cordora, Rainbow Crossing Luxury, and Delamar. Always confirm the exact address with the CCSD zoning search.
Are there new homes coming to Southern Highlands?
Yes. Lennar lists Westridge Enclave and Westridge Square as coming soon, from $700K. Blue Heron is building The Bluffs there now, so ask for current pricing.
